findings.title: A shared route connects 17 wallet aliases
findings.summary: The ECHO case ledger connects 17 of 23 aliases through one intermediate funding route. The remaining six enter the launch window without that same visible path. The graph supports a funding relationship; it does not identify the person behind it.
findings.verifierNote: Shared infrastructure remains a plausible explanation. Keep the cluster provisional.

findings.title: The withdrawal comes before the sell wave
findings.summary: The EXIT timeline places two liquidity withdrawals ahead of the wider selling window. Reverse ordering would support a reactive exit; this ordering leaves pre-positioning as a question worth testing.
findings.verifierNote: Sequence accepted within the case record. Intent requires independent evidence.

findings.title: The insider explanation is not the only explanation
findings.summary: The earliest entries fit both a coordinated launch and an automated arbitrage response. A narrow time window makes the activity unusual, but it does not make one explanation decisive.
findings.verifierNote: The ownership inference has not cleared review. Preserve both hypotheses.

findings.title: The swap pattern repeats an instruction path
findings.summary: The MIRROR ledger contains repeated route fingerprints with a matching retry boundary. That is consistent with a loop in the execution path. It does not establish deliberate volume inflation.
findings.verifierNote: Replace the manipulation claim with the narrower instruction-pattern observation.

findings.title: Three branches leave the intermediate account
findings.summary: The VAULT graph splits into three paths after the intermediate account. Two paths return to known case aliases. The third has no supported owner link and remains outside the attributed cluster.
findings.verifierNote: The unknown branch stays visible. Do not collapse it into the known cluster.

findings.title: Authority history is the next decisive record
findings.summary: The LAST MILE case needs the sequence of authority changes and automation triggers. Price movement alone cannot distinguish an intentional exit from a failed execution policy.
findings.verifierNote: Evidence request approved. Keep motive open until the authority sequence is available.

findings.title: The funding window is wider than the launch window
findings.summary: The eight-second entry window is the headline. The earlier funding interval is the stronger investigative lead because it gives the bureau a separate sequence to compare.
findings.verifierNote: Keep launch timing and funding timing as independent observations.

findings.title: Observation and intent require different verdicts
findings.summary: The two withdrawal records support a statement about order. They do not support a statement about intent. The case file now separates those claims so later evidence can update each independently.
findings.verifierNote: Attribution language narrowed. The sequence remains in the evidence ledger.

findings.title: Three hypotheses survive the first search
findings.summary: The reconstruction matrix keeps bot retry, route aggregation, and intentional repetition in play. The retry explanation fits the instruction order best, while the other two need additional assumptions.
findings.verifierNote: A best fit is a working explanation, not a final attribution.

findings.title: Confidence falls when service overlap is included
findings.summary: Treating a common service as common ownership artificially strengthens the cluster. The revised hypothesis includes service overlap as an independent possibility.
findings.verifierNote: The bureau will not turn infrastructure overlap into a claim about identity.

findings.title: An unresolved path becomes an evidence request
findings.summary: The third funding branch is now a dedicated request rather than an assumed connection. The bureau can progress on the two supported branches without overstating the unknown one.
findings.verifierNote: Scope accepted. The unresolved branch stays on the case board.

findings.title: A case can stay open without losing its shape
findings.summary: The record preserves the observed sequence, the explanations still in play, and the exact evidence needed next. An unresolved verdict is useful when its boundaries are clear.
findings.verifierNote: Case protocol accepted: evidence, explanation, challenge, next question.
